# apt packages the Linux leg of rust-check.yml installs, one per line.
# Whole-line `#` comments only: text after a package name is passed to apt-get.
# The apt archive cache key hashes this file: editing it starts a fresh cache.

# winit's x11+wayland link-time deps; the wayland-csd-adwaita feature pulls
# in xkbcommon + wayland-client.
libxkbcommon-dev
libxkbcommon-x11-dev
libwayland-dev
libxcb-render0-dev
libxcb-shape0-dev
libxcb-xfixes0-dev

# GL / EGL for the native host.
libegl1-mesa-dev
libgles2-mesa-dev
libgbm-dev
mesa-utils

# Skia's system FontMgr (fontconfig + freetype). fonts-noto-cjk (61 MB) gives
# it CJK + Hangul coverage; without it 7 tests fail (probe PR #71): Hangul
# fallback and a top-bar hit test in de-host-native, and the CJK-fixture
# board text wrap / text collision tests in de-orchestrator.
libfreetype-dev
libfontconfig1-dev
fonts-noto-cjk

pkg-config
libssl-dev

# `check-rustls-client-policy.sh` matches with ripgrep's multiline
# + PCRE2 lookahead, which grep cannot replicate portably. Without
# it the script's `rg` calls fail as "command not found" and the
# policy reports a violation that is not there — red on every
# Linux/macOS run since 215100234 introduced the dependency.
ripgrep
